features.name: of__signed_volume
features.description: Net signed traded volume computed as sum of trade_size multiplied by aggressor_side.

features.name: of__imbalance_ratio
features.description: Normalized aggressor imbalance as (buy_volume - sell_volume) divided by total volume.

features.name: of__large_trade_count
features.description: Count of trades in the record exceeding the configured large trade size threshold.

features.name: of__avg_trade_size
features.description: Mean trade size across trades within the record.

features.name: of__time_between_trades
features.description: Average time gap between consecutive trades inside the record in seconds.

features.name: of__aggressor_flag_ratio
features.description: Fraction of trades that are buyer initiated within the record.

features.name: of__trade_price_vs_vwap
features.description: Difference between average trade price and VWAP normalized by VWAP.

features.name: of__run_length_up
features.description: Length of the current consecutive up-tick trade sequence ending in the record.

features.name: of__run_length_down
features.description: Length of the current consecutive down-tick trade sequence ending in the record.

features.name: of__aggressive_buy_size
features.description: Total size of buyer-initiated trades in the record.

features.name: of__aggressive_sell_size
features.description: Total size of seller-initiated trades in the record.

features.name: of__sequence_entropy
features.description: Entropy of the buyer versus seller trade direction sequence within the record.

features.name: of__small_trade_vol
features.description: Volume contributed by trades below the configured small trade threshold.

features.name: of__medium_trade_vol
features.description: Volume contributed by trades between the small and large thresholds.

features.name: of__large_trade_vol
features.description: Volume contributed by trades exceeding the large trade threshold.

features.name: of__vwap_pressure
features.description: Signed difference between VWAP and mid price for the record.

features.name: of__aggressor_volume_ratio
features.description: Ratio of buyer-initiated volume to seller-initiated volume with safe epsilon handling.

features.name: of__execution_flow_polarity
features.description: Direction of dominant aggressor flow encoded as +1 for buys, -1 for sells, 0 neutral.

features.name: of__market_pressure_tilt
features.description: Signed traded volume adjusted by spread and visible depth to capture market pressure.

features.name: of__impact_adjusted_flow
features.description: Signed volume scaled by contemporaneous price impact relative to mid price and spread.

features.name: of__aggression_persistence
features.description: Indicator that the same aggressor side dominates both current and previous records.

features.name: of__trade_burst_intensity
features.description: Trade count normalized by elapsed time within the record to capture burstiness.

features.name: of__toxicity_proxy
features.description: Proxy for informed trading combining signed volume with adverse price movement.

features.name: of__realized_sign_rate
features.description: Fraction of trades whose direction aligns with price movement direction.

features.name: of__price_impact_per_unit_volume
features.description: Absolute price change relative to previous record divided by traded volume.

features.name: of__initiator_persistence
features.description: Probability-like measure that the same initiator side persists across records.

features.name: of__time_decay_of_flow
features.description: Exponentially decayed signed volume contribution from the previous record.
